subject: Audit evidence schedule and sprint plan for Northpoint Bank FFIEC request
messages:
From: Samantha Price <samantha.price@northpointbank.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Liang <tliang@diligentpartners.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: sample evidence + timeline for FFIEC-style control mapping

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking our call last week. Northpoint's audit team is preparing our vendor control review and the regulators flagged a tighter timeline this quarter. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the following by Aug 12: an FFIEC-style control matrix mapped to your product controls, example access logs (7 days), and a network/architecture diagram that highlights customer-isolation controls?

Also, we need a short plan showing who on your side will be responsible for each artifact, an estimate of transfer method (SFTP, shared Drive), and any export/format constraints your security team requires. This is a compliance gate for our procurement and retention policy.

Tom from DiligentPartners is assisting the audit — I've cc'd him for scheduling.

Appreciate a quick confirmation of scope and a proposed delivery schedule.

Best,
Samantha Price
Director, Vendor Risk Management
Northpoint Bank

From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Price <samantha.price@northpointbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: sample evidence + timeline for FFIEC-style control mapping

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear list. We can support the artifacts you requested. High-level plan below; I'll pull in the security and compliance owners for artifact prep.

Proposed delivery sprint (target: Aug 12):
- Week of 7/27: Kickoff and scoping call (complete)
- 7/29–8/04: Prepare draft control matrix and architecture diagram (Marissa lead)
- 8/05–8/08: Pull sanitized access logs and redact PII where required (Karthik lead)
- 8/09–8/11: Internal review and packaging (Markus + Marissa)
- By 8/12: Deliver final package via SFTP and shared Drive link

Transfer method: primary deliverable via SFTP (we can push to your incoming folder) plus a Drive folder for non-sensitive docs. We will provide CSV/XLSX for the matrix, PDF for diagram, and a zip for logs. Attached is a proposed control matrix template and a sample sanitized log extract to show format.

Attachments: ffiec_control_matrix.xlsx (template), access_logs_sample.zip (sanitized sample)

Do you have any special encryption or MD5 checksum requirements for the SFTP transfer? If you can share the host and acceptable user, we will stage files there.

I'll schedule 30 minutes on Thursday to confirm scope with Tom and your audit lead unless you'd prefer an alternate time.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Head of Platform Sales
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: sample evidence + timeline for FFIEC-style control mapping

Markus — noted. I'll take point on the control matrix and the architecture diagram. Plan for the deliverables:
- Control matrix: map FFIEC/FFIEC-AR requirements to Redwood controls (column for control owner, evidence location, and sample artifact reference). I'll use the attached template.
- Network diagram: redacted customer network boundaries and key isolation controls; PDF export.
- Evidence packages: Karthik, can you confirm what level of redaction is needed for the logs and whether we can provide host/port/IP truncation vs. full obfuscation?

Rishi, please confirm whether we should include a commercial note (discount/credits) for expedited delivery — procurement often asks.

I'll prepare an internal checklist and populate the Drive folder with drafts by 8/04.

-Marissa
Sr. Product Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Liang <tliang@diligentpartners.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai, Samantha Price <samantha.price@northpointbank.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2026 10:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: sample evidence + timeline for FFIEC-style control mapping

Thanks — quick clarifications from audit side:
1) Logs: 7 days of auth and admin events; IPs may be masked but timestamps and event IDs must be preserved.
2) Control matrix: include references to SOC 2 controls where applicable.
3) Chain of custody: please include a signed confirmation of who prepared/redacted the artifacts.

SFTP: we'll provide an incoming folder. Samantha, can you send host/username and whether RSA key auth is required?

Regards,
Tom Liang
Lead IT Auditor
Diligent Partners

From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Price <samantha.price@northpointbank.com>, Tom Liang <tliang@diligentpartners.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deliverables schedule confirmation + SFTP prep

Samantha/Tom — thanks for the clarifications. We will:
- Provide 7 days of auth/admin events with IP masking (retain event IDs/timestamps)
- Cross-reference SOC 2 control mappings in the FFIEC matrix
- Provide a signed artifact preparation attestation (PDF) with names and roles

SFTP: please send host and auth method. If RSA key is required, we will provision a key and send the public key to your team. Otherwise we can provide username/password over our secure channel.

I've created a shared Drive folder and staged initial drafts (internal only) here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleLink

Marissa will upload the draft matrix and diagram by 8/04; Karthik will upload the sanitized logs on 8/08. I'll run an internal review on 8/09 and push final package to your SFTP on 8/12.

Attachments: network-architecture-diagram.pdf (draft)

Best,
Markus
Head of Platform Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Price <samantha.price@northpointbank.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Liang <tliang@diligentpartners.com>, audit@northpointbank.com
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 15:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit evidence schedule and sprint plan for Northpoint Bank FFIEC request

Markus — this looks good and appreciated. Host for SFTP is audits.northpointbank.com, folder /incoming/NPB-2026. We require RSA key auth; please send your public key to audit@northpointbank.com. MD5 checksums are preferred but not required.

One ask: can you also include a short readme (1 page) per artifact describing redaction approach and retention recommendations? That will speed sign-off.

If you can deliver by 8/12 as planned, procurement will proceed with the vendor questionnaire. I'll expect your public key and the final package.

Thanks,
Samantha Price
Director, Vendor Risk Management
Northpoint Bank
